\(\sin\left(A+\frac{B}{2}\right) + \sin\left(B+\frac{C}{2}\right) + \sin\left(C+\frac{A}{2}\right) - \sin A - \sin B - \sin C\le0\)

views.lean_signature:
open Real Set
open scoped Real


theorem triangle_ineq (A B C : Real) (hA : A ∈ Ioo 0 π)
  (hB : B ∈ Ioo 0 π) (hC : C ∈ Ioo 0 π) (hABC : A + B + C = π) :
  sin (A + B / 2) + sin (B + C / 2) + sin (C + A / 2) -
  sin A - sin B - sin C ≤ 0

Prove that if \(x\) and \(y\) are positive integers that satisfy the system of equations
\[
\log_{10} x + 2 \log_{10} (\text{gcd}(x,y)) = 60
\]
\[
\log_{10} y + 2 \log_{10} (\text{lcm}(x,y)) = 570
\]
and \(m\) is the number of (not necessarily distinct) prime factors in the prime factorization of \(x\), and \(n\) is the number of (not necessarily distinct) prime factors in the prime factorization of \(y\), then \(3m + 2n = 880\).

theorem prove {x y : ℕ} (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y)
    (h1 : Real.logb 10 x + 2 * Real.logb 10 (Nat.gcd x y) = 60)
    (h2 : Real.logb 10 y + 2 * Real.logb 10 (Nat.lcm x y) = 570)
    (m n : ℕ) (hm : m = (Nat.primeFactors x).card)
    (hn : n = (Nat.primeFactors y).card) :
    3 * m + 2 * n = 880
